owner_request: Record every identified source, what it can search, how to query it, ten different verified examples, and keep expanding the inventory. Use simple Git-tracked JSON; no SQL or hosted datastore.

milestones.objective: Persist the first ten candidates with ten distinct positive query examples each.
Triage every existing playbook lead, resolving named/unlinked candidates; give each actual catalog a canonical identity and reviewed/deferred/rejected decision.

Extend discovery through all six groups, 20 content categories, 20 industry tags and nine USA/India public tracks. Work toward 100 qualified origins per category/industry where evidence supports it; document genuine shortfalls.

counting_rules: A URL or directory is a lead, not a source. Deduplicate origins, language variants, mirrors and shared connectors.
Only latest successful observations of distinct current query requests count toward ten; failures/retries/empty results do not.
Ten known-item searches verify retrieval only; production qualification needs topic relevance, rights, reliability, access and UI tests.
Record overlap, geography and India/USA gaps; never inflate counts to meet a target.

execution.batch_size: 1–3 candidates; serial provider calls with documented limits/backoff
execution.cursor: Continue G02: technical documentation (Python/Sphinx inventory), curricula (DIKSHA/NCERT supported metadata), courses and vocational guides. Then G03–G06; revisit G01 deferred and India-owned catalog gaps.

continuation.title: Expand source registry
continuation.note: Creation confirmed; future execution/access is not guaranteed. Resume instructions and scope are in README.md.

constraints: Research only; do not enable app sources, import runtime catalogs or deploy.
No new database service, SQL, Redis, paid API or account setup.
No CAPTCHA/WAF bypass or bulk full-work copying; retain small metadata evidence.
completion_definition: Every currently identified lead has been triaged; every retained queryable candidate has documented capabilities, policy and ten verified query examples. Expansion targets remain active until evidence supports them or the owner accepts a documented shortfall; no claim of exhaustive internet coverage.
